candidate_descriptions.trend_breakout: 15m close outside prior 20 highs/lows, EMA50/200 direction; 1.5 ATR14 stop, 3 ATR14 target, maximum 32 bars.
candidate_descriptions.range_reversion: 15m Bollinger20/2SD re-entry with ADX14 <20; 1.5 ATR14 stop, frozen SMA20 target exceeding stop distance plus signal-level costs, maximum 16 bars.
candidate_descriptions.opening_range: First close outside complete 00:00–00:59 UTC range; opposite edge stop, 2R target, one signal/day, maximum 92 bars.
candidate_descriptions.hourly_bb_reentry: Completed-hour Bollinger20/2SD re-entry; 1.5 hourly ATR14 stop, frozen hourly SMA20 target exceeding 0.5R plus signal-level costs, maximum 16 bars.
candidate_descriptions.previous_day_failure: 15m sweep and rejection of one previous complete UTC day edge; signal extreme plus 0.25 ATR14 stop, previous-day midpoint target exceeding 1R plus signal-level costs, maximum 32 bars.
candidate_descriptions.opening_range_fade: Fade first close outside complete 00:00–00:59 UTC range; 2 box-width stop, opposite edge target exceeding signal-level costs, one signal/day, maximum 32 bars.
candidate_descriptions.hourly_trend_breakout: Completed-hour close outside prior 20 hourly highs/lows with EMA50/200 direction; 1.5 hourly ATR14 stop, 3 ATR14 target, maximum 32 bars.
candidate_descriptions.ema_pullback: Completed-hour EMA20/50/200 ordered trend and close recrosses EMA20 after pullback, ADX14 >=20; 2 hourly ATR14 stop, 4 ATR14 target, maximum 24 bars.
candidate_descriptions.atr_channel: Completed-hour close outside prior 20 hourly highs/lows, EMA200 direction and ADX14 >=25; 2 hourly ATR14 stop, 4 ATR14 target, maximum 32 bars.
candidate_descriptions.rsi_trend: Completed-hour RSI14 crosses 45 upward/55 downward with EMA50/200 trend; 1.5 hourly ATR14 stop, 3 ATR14 target, maximum 24 bars.

selection.eligible: At 5x: at least 30 completed validation trades, positive development net profit and positive validation net profit. Choose highest validation net profit; ties favor trade count then declared candidate order.
selection.failed_fallback: If none is eligible, choose highest validation net profit among candidates with at least 30 validation trades, explicitly labelled failed_screen_fallback.
selection.insufficient_sample: If none has 30 validation trades, display highest validation net profit with any validation trades as insufficient_sample; if none trades, select nothing. Neither fallback is an eligible strategy.
selection.forbidden: No selection or retuning using reused_test, reused_recent, later_check, higher leverage or cost stress.

timing: Completed 15m/hourly signal, next 15m open entry before 20:00 UTC, maximum two entries/day, complete UTC opening box, flat by day-end; hourly hypotheses require 220 prior complete hours.
accounting: Each asset/window/leverage/stress starts afresh with $20 and ends flat. This is neither a continuous account nor a shared two-asset $20 portfolio. Gross P&L minus fees and signed funding must reconcile to final cash.
funding: Observed Hyperliquid hourly rates settle at hourly OPEN for carried positions. Binance mark-open proxies unavailable oracle prices. Missing rate is adverse 0.00125% per hour for either direction. Stress is always adverse 0.01% per hour.
liquidation: Small-notional current mainnet maintenance: ETH 2%, SOL 2.5%. Isolated liquidation conservatively loses remaining isolated collateral including accumulated funding credits, while unrelated free cash remains. Actual matching/backstop not reconstructed.
evidence: Frozen before this experiment computes any returns. Earlier dates are reused. Later_check has 15 days new to this study, not globally untouched dates or prospective evidence.
limitations: Research only. No wallet, order, account-permission or live leverage changes.
Binance USD-M trade and mark candles proxy Hyperliquid execution and liquidation. This is not a single-venue reconstruction.
Observed Hyperliquid funding uses Binance mark-open as an oracle-price proxy; exact historical oracle prices are unavailable.
Hourly funding is settled at the open for carried positions, before new entries. Scheduled preceding-close exits precede settlement; exact same-time matching cannot be reconstructed.
Missing funding uses an explicit adverse 0.00125% per hour for either direction; stress uses adverse 0.01% per hour.
Liquidation conservatively loses remaining isolated collateral. Actual order-book liquidation may retain some margin; no liquidation clearance fee is added.
Known open gap exits precede later mark extremes. When intrabar order is unknown, liquidation precedes stops, and stops precede targets.
Current mainnet quantity precision and small-notional maintenance tiers are held constant historically. Testnet and historical tiers can differ.
Drawdown is marked at 15-minute closes and modeled exits, not tick-by-tick. Failed stops, latency and market depth are unavailable.
Each run starts with fresh collateral and ends flat. Separate ETH/SOL runs are not a simultaneous shared-$20 portfolio.
The $20 is assumed already deposited collateral. Deposit, withdrawal, bridge, network and tax costs are excluded.
Ten hypotheses and multiple assets/leverage levels create selection bias. Previously examined dates are reused research; historical profit is not evidence of future profit.
Seven hypotheses transfer from previously inspected research; three additional hourly definitions are fixed before this study's returns. All ten are disclosed.
Development, validation, reused_test and reused_recent calendar data were already used in earlier research. Selection is adaptive research, not untouched confirmation.
The 15-day later_check is new to this study, but its calendar dates already exist and are not claimed globally pristine or prospective.
The 5x candidate is selected independently per asset from development eligibility and validation ranking only. Later returns, leverage sensitivity and stress never change the selected candidate.
All ten candidates are published at baseline 5x in every window, including failures. Only the validation-selected candidate receives detailed leverage/stress runs.
Positive results after modeled costs remain historical simulation. Small samples, multiple comparisons, proxy prices and parameter selection prevent a future-profit claim.
Cost stress deliberately changes sizing through the same risk budget as well as fill/funding costs. It is a complete rerun, not a fee-only subtraction from baseline trades.
Signal reward gates use fixed 0.045% fee plus 2bps slippage per side at signal close. Entry gaps may change reward/risk, and the simulator rejects entries beyond stop or target.
